edits.original: Access checks default to fail-closed, rather than open.
edits.reason: "rather than open" is a redundant antonym trailer: "open" is the ordinary, general-knowledge antonym of "fail-closed" in this context, so the clause adds no new information and should be cut.

edits.original: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose, rather than by accident.
